svg.text: U1 · Account, sign in and consent
Accounts by invitation only. Entra External ID through the API (backend for frontend): tokens stay on the server, the browser gets an HTTP-only cookie (ADR-0010). Alternatives are
alt frames (success path in green); red ✗ = state after an infrastructure failure. SLA targets are proposals (p95).
U1 · Account · the owner invites each family member by hand; self-service sign-up is disabled in the user flow
1. Invite external user { e-mail } (the Microsoft invitation e-mail off)
2. user { oid, state: PendingAcceptance } (no identity provider yet)
3. own message with the link https://…/?domain_hint=google (first sign-in only)
U1 · Sign in · once, then a session · target: < 2 s after the identity provider
✗ API asleep: waits for the cold start
Every start after sleep is a new container. The cookie keys (ASP.NET Data Protection) are kept
in Blob Storage, wrapped by a Key Vault key, so sessions survive sleep and new deployments.
6. sign in with Google, or e-mail with a one-time code (the first sign-in redeems the invitation)
✗ Entra down: no sign-in; nothing stored
7. "account does not exist"; the API is never reached
10. page "Sign-in did not finish. Try again." (nothing stored)
13. sign the client assertion with the certificate (managed identity; cached)
✗ Key Vault down and nothing cached: 503, the user tries again
✗ code expired or used: as the error alt above
15. id_token { oid, name } (tokens stay on the server; e-mail not requested)
17. SELECT User, Consent(current text version) WHERE User.ExternalId=@oid
18. page "Your account is being deleted"; no session
19. 302 / + Set-Cookie: session { userId } (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax; 8 h, sliding)
[no user yet, or an active user]
[the user cancels at Google, or Entra returns an error]
U1 · Consent · before the first import; withdrawing it is U10
22. what is stored and processed, by whom and for how long; a checkbox
24. TX: INSERT User(userId = new UUIDv7, ExternalId = oid) (if new); INSERT Consent(userId, version, givenAt); COMMIT
✗ rollback: nothing stored; UI asks again
26. "Without your consent we must delete your account and all your data." → confirm
29. cookie cleared; nothing about the person in our database
30. log ConsentDeclined { oid } → alert to the owner
31. alert e-mail: remove the account in Entra (by hand)
[the person declines, and has an account (a newer consent text)]
[the person declines, with no account yet]
[no user yet, or consent to an older text version]
The user row is created together with the consent, so a person who declines leaves nothing in our database.
Sign-in: oid → User.ExternalId → userId, our own UUIDv7 (ADR-0015). Every later request: cookie → userId; SQL sets SESSION_CONTEXT(userId) for Row-Level Security.
U1 · Sign out, or the session ends
34. cookie cleared; 302 → Entra end-session → back to /
After 8 h without a request the cookie expires: the next request is "GET / with no valid session cookie" above.
plaintext original or unmasked personal data
note: a fact, e.g. the user closes the browser
✗ if this step fails: state of the system
